Subject: Rendale Office Partners - Referral Required

Hi Tomas,

Thanks for the submission on Rendale Office Partners. I've reviewed the information and everything looks complete—appreciate the thorough package.

However, I'll need to refer this to our senior underwriting team since we handle Louisiana accounts on a referral basis. Before I send it up, can you help me with a few questions?

- Are all three locations in Louisiana, or are any in other states?
- What's the primary occupancy at each location?
- Any high-hazard tenants or vacant space we should know about?

Once I have these details, I'll get this in front of the team quickly. If this doesn't work out, I'd recommend reaching out to a surplus lines broker who specializes in Gulf Coast property risks.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
